data.gender_notes: Donelle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Donelle is a modern English name derived from the Old English word 'dōn,' meaning 'gift,' and the Old French word 'elle,' meaning 'she.' It can be interpreted as 'gift from God.'. The name Donelle carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Donelle usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of the gift of life and the blessings bestowed upon us by the divine.
data.etymology: Donelle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Donelle total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Donelle is a unique and yet beautiful name that has gained popularity in recent times. Its combining the Old English and Old French roots makes it a fusion of two ancient languages, which can be seen as a reflection of the multicultural and diverse world we live in today. Donelle's meaning as a 'gift from God' also adds to its allure, as many parents opt for names that have a spiritual and religious significance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Donelle carries a profound spiritual significance, as it reflects the belief in the divine origin of all things. The name 'Donelle' serves as a reminder that every human being is a gift from God and possesses inherent worth and value. It also references the biblical concept of the gift of life and the gift of salvation through faith, further emphasizing the spiritual and religious significance of the name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Donelle: Derived from the Hebrew name "Dawid," meaning "beloved," and the French name "Elle," meaning "she," symbolizing a beloved woman of God.

The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
